<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 180.042 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈179.035 Da. Considering the isotopic pattern (~10 % M+1 intensity) suggests about 9–10 carbons. Testing plausible formulas with C, H, O, and one nitrogen, the composition C₉H₉NO₃ matches the exact mass within a few ppm (calculated monoisotopic mass = 179.058 Da, very close to the observed value) and fits the DBE of 6 typical for aromatic/hetero‑aromatic structures. Therefore the molecular formula is C9H9NO3.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H9NO3</final_answer>
